audio_description:
A narrow horizontal slot frames the distant glowing parade structure across the dark plain.
Edea on her float beneath the energy ring.
The view pushes toward the Sorceress.
A striking close-up of Edea's face fills the screen.

context.scene_title: The parade climax / sniper setup — the view toward the gate and the dramatic close-up of Sorceress Edea just before the assassination attempt (Disc 1).
locations: Deling City at night — a framed view (as if through a narrow embrasure/scope) toward the illuminated parade structure, then Edea's float and a final tight close-up of her face

characters.name: Sorceress Edea
characters.recognition: Golden-skinned face with yellow eyes, ram-horn headpiece and jeweled crown; shown first on her float beneath the blue ring and then in a large dramatic close-up.

characters.name: (Galbadian soldier / onlooker in red)
characters.recognition: A red-uniformed figure stands in the foreground of the float shot; not individually named.

context.summary: A narrow horizontal slot frames the distant glowing parade structure across the dark plain — evoking the snipers' vantage. The camera then finds Edea on her float beneath the turquoise energy ring, before pushing in to a striking close-up of the Sorceress's face, building tension toward the assassination attempt.
context.context_note: High confidence: Edea during the Deling City parade; the framed opening shot is interpreted as the snipers' line of sight.
